title: Molten Silver Sphere
summary: Pure visual cutaway: a glossy molten silver liquid-metal sphere hovers in a pitch-black cave, pulsating to an unseen deep beat while cavern walls snap between high-contrast checkerboard and electric neon line grids. Three maxed-detail video prompt variations — slow zoom, orbital neon veins, and macro chromium dive.
visualArc: Black cavern void → hovering chrome sphere → checkerboard ↔ neon wall flashes → chromatic reflections on liquid metal → camera closes in (zoom / orbit / macro).

segments.geminiOmniPrompt: A detailed cinematic 8K photoreal video of a glossy molten silver sphere of liquid metal hovering precisely in the center of a pitch-black cave. Seamless camera slow zoom steadily approaches the sphere from medium-wide to tight close-up, emphasizing complex liquid-metal textures and the dramatic play of strobing light in the dark space. Continuous single shot, no cuts, photoreal short film, ~12–15 seconds.
